_description: Manual relation-type-resolution ground truth, consumed by the ETCDR evaluation harness during the canonicalisation pre-step. Each cluster lists relation_type strings (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE, as emitted) that denote the same predicate and should all normalise to the same canonical relation_type. The harness builds a normalize_map (alias -> canonical) from this file and rewrites the relation_type column of the extracted relationships before running ETCDR.
